episodeTitle.en: 84 minutes of enterprise sales alpha | Jen Abel
episodeTitle.zh: 84 分钟的企业销售实战心得｜Jen Abel

guestBioOfficial.zh: Jen Abel 是 JJellyfish 联合创始人，录制时担任 State Affairs 企业销售总经理。这是她第三次受访。她长期亲自参与企业交易，尤其关注内部支持者、试用证据和谈判节奏怎样推动签约。
guestBioOfficial.en: Jen co-founded JJellyfish and runs enterprise sales at State Affairs. In her third appearance, she draws on hands-on experience with internal champions, pilots, and negotiations.

title.en: 84 minutes of enterprise sales alpha | Jen Abel
title.zh: 84 分钟的企业销售实战心得｜Jen Abel

summary.zh: Jen 和 Lenny 把一笔企业订单从首次通话推演到合同修改。最值得对着自己的交易看的，是三个容易卡住的时刻：买方第一次愿意透露实情、内部有人迟迟不表态，以及法务发回一长串修改意见。
summary.en: Jen and Lenny walk through an enterprise deal from first call to contract redlines. The conversation pauses at the points where early candor, a silent stakeholder, or a long legal review can change the outcome.

insights.title: 第一次通话里的坦诚有时限
insights.detail: 客户还没把对话当成正式销售流程时，往往更愿意谈真实处境。Jen 会留出空间听清问题，也借此建立后续对话的信任。
insights.detailEn: Buyers may be more candid before a conversation starts feeling like a sales process. Jen uses the first call to listen and build trust.
insights.titleEn: Make room for candor on the first call

insights.title: 遇到沉默的利益相关方，争取一次用户对话
insights.detail: 与其反复催内部支持者给决定，Jen 会提出花十五到二十分钟听实际用户说说需求，让潜在阻力具体起来。
insights.detailEn: When a deal goes quiet, ask the champion for a short conversation with a user who can explain what is getting in the way.
insights.titleEn: Ask for time with an actual user

insights.title: 合同改动太多时，换一种沟通方式
insights.detail: 先接受容易处理的条款。如果剩下的修改已经让邮件往返变慢，就拉相关人通话，逐项处理分歧。
insights.detailEn: Accept straightforward redlines first. If the rest are slowing the deal through email, get the relevant people together on a call.
insights.titleEn: Take complex redlines to a call

related.reason: 回到第一期，先看创始人怎样拿到最初的销售对话。
related.reasonEn: How a founder gets the first sales conversations.

related.reason: 看单笔成交以后，怎样把企业销售从百万美元做到千万美元。
related.reasonEn: How to scale enterprise sales after the first deals close.
